title: Mean and Variance Estimation Complexity in Arbitrary Distributions via Wasserstein Minimization
abstract: arXiv:2501.10172v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Parameter estimation is a fundamental challenge in machine learning, crucial for tasks such as neural network weight fitting and Bayesian inference. This paper focuses on the complexity of estimating translation $\boldsymbol{\mu} \in \mathbb{R}^l$ and shrinkage $\sigma \in \mathbb{R}_{++}$ parameters for a distribution of the form $\frac{1}{\sigma^l} f_0 \left( \frac{\boldsymbol{x} - \boldsymbol{\mu}}{\sigma} \right)$, where $f_0$ is a known density in $\mathbb{R}^l$ given $n$ samples. We highlight that while the problem is NP-hard for Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), it is possible to obtain $\varepsilon$-approximations for arbitrary $\varepsilon > 0$ within $\text{poly} \left( \frac{1}{\varepsilon} \right)$ time using the Wasserstein distance.

translated_title: 基于Wasserstein最小化的任意分布均值与方差估计复杂度研究
translated_abstract: 参数估计是机器学习中的一项根本性挑战，对于神经网络权重拟合和贝叶斯推断等任务至关重要。本文研究了在给定 $n$ 个样本的情况下，估计形如 $\frac{1}{\sigma^l} f_0\left(\frac{\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{\mu}}{\sigma}\right)$ 的分布的平移参数 $\boldsymbol{\mu} \in \mathbb{R}^l$ 与尺度参数 $\sigma \in \mathbb{R}_{++}$ 的计算复杂度，其中 $f_0$ 是 $\mathbb{R}^l$ 上已知的密度函数。我们着重指出，尽管该问题对于最大似然估计（MLE）而言是NP难的，但利用Wasserstein距离，可以在 $\text{poly}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\right)$ 时间内对任意 $\varepsilon > 0$ 获得 $\varepsilon$-近似解。
tldr: 本文揭示了任意分布下均值与方差参数估计的复杂度：虽然最大似然估计是NP难的，但利用Wasserstein距离可在关于 $1/\varepsilon$ 的多项式时间内获得任意精度的 $\varepsilon$-近似解。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the complexity of estimating mean and variance parameters for arbitrary distributions, showing that although MLE is NP-hard, ε-approximations can be achieved in poly(1/ε) time via Wasserstein distance minimization.
